lines: ① Hold the handle and sit bottom-first.
② Knees together, swing both legs in.
③ Getting out, put both feet down first.
④ Use the side step slowly if there is one.

caption:
Koko climbs in and out of her new SUV every day, and lately her back twinges each time.

Stepping up one leg first while twisting can leave your back doing most of the work. Sitting bottom-first and swinging both legs in together may make it easier.

Hybi's tip: hold the handle and sit bottom-first, keep your knees together and swivel both legs in, and when getting out, put both feet on the ground before you stand.

Pain spreading down your leg, numbness or weakness are worth an assessment. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio 🚙
